name: What is the average cost of a whole house renovation in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a whole house renovation in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a whole house renovation in Los Angeles can vary widely due to factors like home size, the extent of desired changes, material selections, and specific site conditions. A basic refresh might start from $100 per square foot, while a high-end, luxury renovation with extensive structural work and premium finishes could exceed $400 per square foot, or more. It's best to discuss your specific vision with a contractor to receive a detailed, customized estimate tailored to your project and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary significantly in Los Angeles, from roughly $100 per square foot for basic updates to over $400 per square foot for luxury renovations, depending on scope and materials.
